$comment: Master specification §17: track release artifact size on every build, set
budgets after baseline measurement, and alert on regression.
Every baseline below was measured, not estimated — the command that
produced each artifact is recorded next to it. A ceiling is the baseline
plus the headroom named in `allowedGrowth`, chosen per artifact rather
than as one global percentage: a 5% drift in a 42 MB web bundle is two
megabytes a user waits for, while 5% of a 4 MB iOS binary is noise.
Raising a ceiling is a deliberate act with a reason attached. That is the
point of keeping this in the repository rather than in CI configuration:
the diff shows who decided a release could get bigger, and why.

artifacts.label: Android universal APK
artifacts.note: Carries native libraries for all four ABIs. Play delivers from the AAB and splits per device, so this is a sideloading artifact and must not be quoted as an install size.

artifacts.label: Android app bundle
artifacts.note: What Play actually receives. A per-device download is a fraction of this.

artifacts.label: Web initial JavaScript
artifacts.note: What a first paint needs. The pose worker is excluded deliberately: it is fetched only when someone opens Move.

artifacts.label: Web WASM runtime
artifacts.producedBy: scripts/fetch-pose-model.mjs, run by the Web build
artifacts.note: Runtime-cached on first use rather than precached, so it is not paid at install. Pinned by digest, so growth here means the pinned runtime changed.

$comment: Named so their absence is a recorded decision rather than an oversight.
Each needs something CI does not have, and each says what that is.
unbudgeted.ios-ipa: Needs a signed archive. A personal Apple team cannot sign this app's entitlements, so no IPA has been produced yet to measure. The unsigned Release .app bundle is 4.4 MB; a budget waits for the real artifact.
unbudgeted.cold-start: Needs a physical device. A simulator's launch time measures this Mac.
unbudgeted.warm-start: Needs a physical device, for the same reason.
unbudgeted.memory: Needs a device run with the camera and the estimators live; a headless number would describe nothing users experience.
unbudgeted.cpu-gpu-thermal-battery: Needs sustained on-device capture. These move together under a real workout and are meaningless sampled apart from one.
unbudgeted.network-usage: Needs a paired session on a device. The realtime path is event-driven, so a synthetic number would not resemble a real pairing.
